title: Few days in: AI-built souls-like where you can't swing a sword, only a bowgun
author: Sad_Network3765
selftext:
Sinfall - a souls like game dev project using bow gun to kill enemies that i have started developing a week ago.

Stack: Opus 5.5 + Fable 5.2 , Gemini Neon. Roughly 90% AI-made; I handle design, feel and polish.

The assets part are made with blender , Claude made script to make them, this part  is the most token consumed. Animations are made with my custom pipelines developed with claude .

I have developed multiple internal self checking systems for the game to detect bugs,positions,balance etc, but it still needs manual fix, which is the 10% of human come from, and this matters because the game you building is for human to play, only a human can verify things from the AI built.

Steam page is coming. Feedback on the combat feel is very welcome. What do you think about this game?

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body:
Great job so far. One major problem many soulslike wannabe games suffer from is how unfair some of the enemy attacks are. There needs to be some frames of a wind-up before they attack or they are just considered cheap swings that go from walking to attacking in a split second.

That and also the hitboxes are important. So you need a really refined & fair battle mechanics to pull off a soulslike without too many people hating on it. 

 Need to add more variety in paths rather than a straight line, and more weapons to keep controls fresh. Maybe with different reload times, different damage, arrows before reloading, etc.

replies.author: Sad_Network3765
replies.body: thx! yea the balance and map making are hard, but so it's important, that's one thing AI cannot do very good.
